news.h: DOJ charges ex-FBI Director James Comey in new case

news.h: Dividend stocks are having an excellent October as tech sector struggles

news.h: Sorry investors, but there’s no such thing as an early ‘Santa Claus rally.’ Here’s when the real gains typically happen.
